pairsWith.noteUz: Communication qismi coursebook 10–11-betlarga, Reading coursebook 6-betga, so'z tartibi grammar 7-bet Ex.9 ga mos keladi.

scanNote.uz: Skanerlangan nusxada qo'lyozma javoblar bor. Ex.16 (T/F) TO'LIQ TO'G'RI bajarilgan, lekin Ex.13 va Ex.15 da tizimli xato bor: SO'ROQ GAPDA SO'Z TARTIBI. O'quvchi 'How old you are?' deb yozgan — bu o'zbekcha tartib. Inglizchada fe'l EGADAN OLDIN keladi: 'How old ARE YOU?'

exercises.instructionEn: Read the dialogue and fill in the missing questions, then in pairs read it out.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialogni o'qing va yetishmayotgan savollarni yozing, so'ng juftlikda o'qib chiqing.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBGA qarab SAVOLNI tiklaysiz.

ENG MUHIM QOIDA — so'roq gapda so'z tartibi:
SO'ROQ SO'Z + FE'L + EGA ?
• How old ARE YOU?  (You are emas!)
• Where ARE YOU from?  (you are emas!)

O'zbekchada 'Necha yoshdasiz?' — fe'l oxirida. Inglizchada esa fe'l egadan OLDIN keladi. Bu eng ko'p qilinadigan xato.

commonMistake.whyUz: So'z tartibi XATO. So'roqda fe'l egadan OLDIN: 'How old ARE YOU?'
FE'L TUSHIB QOLGAN. To'g'risi: 'Where ARE you from?' Ingliz tilida fe'lsiz gap bo'lmaydi.

lines.en: I'm from Manchester, England. Are you from Manchester too?
lines.uz: Men Manchesterdan, Angliyadan. Siz ham Manchesterdanmisiz?

lines.en: No, I'm not. I'm from Swansea.

commonMistake.whyUz: Bu tabiiy ibora emas. To'g'ri variantlar: 'What's your job?' yoki 'What do you do?'
Yana o'sha xato — o'quvchi qoidani tushunmagan, shuning uchun takrorlagan.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the short dialogues and fill in the gaps.
exercises.instructionUz: Qisqa dialoglarni o'qing va bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
Tanishtirish uch kishilik: A tanishtiradi, B va C bir-biri bilan salomlashadi.
Qolip: birinchisi 'Pleased to meet you', ikkinchisi '..., too' qo'shadi.
Diqqat: kim avval gapirsa — 'Pleased to meet you'; javob beruvchi — 'Pleased to meet you, TOO'.

lines.en: Hello, John. John, this is Cindy. She's my friend from Canada.
lines.uz: Salom, John. John, bu Cindy. U mening Kanadadan kelgan do'stim.

lines.en: Hello, Tracy. Tracy, this is Steve. He's my friend from Spain.
lines.uz: Salom, Tracy. Tracy, bu Steve. U mening Ispaniyadan kelgan do'stim.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the words in the correct order to form sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: So'zlarni to'g'ri tartibda joylashtirib gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
Tartib qoidasi:
EGA + be + (SON) + qolgani

Yosh qolipi: SON + years old — 'thirty years old' (old thirty years EMAS).
Gap boshida KATTA harf, oxirida NUQTA.

commonMistake.whyUz: 'years old' — buzilmas ibora, SONDAN KEYIN keladi: thirty years old.
Ikki xato: gap boshida katta harf (His), va Britan imlosi (favouRite).
Uch xato: 1) 'the' Pyramids oldiga keladi, 2) mamlakat oldidan 'the' YO'Q (in Egypt), 3) bu so'roq emas — tasdiq gap, shuning uchun 'The Pyramids are' tartibida.
Faqat bitta xato: gap boshida KATTA harf — 'She'.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the sentences 1 to 6, then read the texts and mark the sentences T (true) or F (false).
exercises.instructionUz: 1–6 gaplarni o'qing, so'ng matnlarni o'qib, gaplarni T (to'g'ri) yoki F (noto'g'ri) deb belgilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
T/F mashqida tuzoq bo'ladi: gap matndagi so'zlarni ishlatadi, lekin ma'nosi boshqacha.
Masalan 5-gap: 'Mark is a basketball player' — matnda 'basketball' bor, lekin u Markning KASBI emas, SEVIMLI SPORTI. Shuning uchun F.
Har doim: kasb (job) va sevimli sport (favourite sport) ni ajrating.

items.whyUz: TUZOQ: basketbol — uning SEVIMLI SPORTI, kasbi emas. Kasbi — pochtachi (postman).
Julie'ning sevimli sporti — voleybol. Futbol — Omarniki.

exercises.scanNote: Skanerdagi o'quvchi bu mashqni TO'LIQ TO'G'RI bajargan (F, T, F, T, F, F).

exercises.instructionEn: Use the information from the table below to write a short paragraph about Juliet. Use text A in Ex. 16 as a model.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi jadvaldagi ma'lumotdan foydalanib Juliet haqida qisqa matn yozing. Ex. 16 dagi A matnini namuna qilib oling.
exercises.explanationUz:
Namuna matn (A) tuzilishi — aynan shu tartibda yozasiz:
1) This is + ISM.
2) He's/She's from + SHAHAR, MAMLAKAT.
3) ISM + is + YOSH + years old.
4) He's/She's + a/an + KASB.
5) His/Her favourite sport is + SPORT.

Juliet — ayol, shuning uchun She's va Her ishlatiladi.
'waitress' — 'w' undosh → A waitress.
exercises.modelAnswer: This is Juliet. She's from Paris, France. Juliet is twenty-two years old. She's a waitress. Her favourite sport is tennis.
exercises.modelAnswerUz: Bu Juliet. U Parijdan, Fransiyadan. Juliet yigirma ikki yoshda. U ofitsiantka. Uning sevimli sporti — tennis.

wordFormation.introUz: Bu sahifadagi kasb va egalik shakllari.

groups.explanationUz: Ba'zi kasblarning ayol shakli -ess bilan yasaladi. Hozirgi ingliz tilida ko'pchiligi eskirib bormoqda, lekin 'waitress' hali ham keng ishlatiladi.
Sport turiga 'player' qo'shilsa, o'sha sport bilan shug'ullanuvchi chiqadi. LEKIN bu KASB degani emas!

sentencePatterns.introUz: Unit 1 ning yakuniy qoliplari — yozma ish uchun kerak bo'ladi.

patterns.exampleEn: How old are you? / Where are you from?
patterns.explanationUz: ENG MUHIM QOIDA. Fe'l egadan OLDIN keladi. 'How old you are' — XATO. Skanerdagi o'quvchi buni 3 marta xato qilgan.

patterns.exampleEn: This is Juliet. She's from Paris, France. Juliet is twenty-two years old. She's a waitress. Her favourite sport is tennis.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu Juliet. U Parijdan, Fransiyadan. Juliet yigirma ikki yoshda. U ofitsiantka. Uning sevimli sporti — tennis.
patterns.explanationUz: Unit 1 ning YAKUNIY ko'nikmasi: jadvaldagi ma'lumotni 5 ta gapga aylantirish. Tartib: ism → joy → yosh → kasb → sevimli sport.

patterns.formula: TANISHTIRISH: X, this is Y. He's/She's my friend from + MAMLAKAT.
patterns.exampleEn: John, this is Cindy. She's my friend from Canada.
patterns.exampleUz: John, bu Cindy. U mening Kanadadan kelgan do'stim.
patterns.explanationUz: Uchinchi shaxsni tanishtirish. Javob: 'Pleased to meet you.' → 'Pleased to meet you, too.'
